seo.description: Renovation, concrete scanning and core drilling services in Greater Vancouver. Explore framing, drywall, flooring, tile, painting and more with VV Renovation.

intro.heading: Renovation & Concrete Services in Vancouver
intro.text: VV Renovation delivers renovation, concrete scanning and core drilling services for residential and commercial projects across the Greater Vancouver Area — Vancouver, Burnaby, Surrey, Richmond, Langley, Coquitlam, North Vancouver and beyond. Explore our services and tell us about your project.
